commits.messageBody:
Use uint32_t for the five AutoDeltaVector callback indices. The archive callback contract remains unsigned 32-bit while size_t becomes 64-bit on x64; callback bodies and wire bytes are unchanged.

Native v120 candidate snapshot builds clientGame on Win32 and x64 in Debug and Release; Win32 product builds pass. This is compiler contract coverage, not live group or creature replication acceptance.
commits.messageHeadline: game: match fixed-width archive callback indices on x64
